body:
Greg's rule, relayed by Fable2 #5168 on 2026-11-04: „trzeba robic po skończonej pracy a nie czekac az braknie miejsca na dysku”. When an item closes or a candidate is superseded and its evidence recorded, remove its worktrees, target/ and temporary files, after a path check, and say in the closing note what was removed. If something stays, name the reason and when it goes. Never remove what an open item or a running job needs. Nothing on Windows B.

Traps:
- `git worktree remove` also deletes `.git/worktrees/<name>/review-runs`, the run's original artifacts (cost on w-d428: test-409026dd). Before removing, check nobody has been asked to read those; copy what an open item needs to .evidence/ and record when it goes.
- A dirty worktree may hold unlanded work: check before removing. Removing target/ alone is safe, since it only costs a rebuild (2026-11-04: 18 target dirs, 159 GB).
